notes: v278 — CONNECT-PICK PERSISTENCE + L2 ONE-TIME ITEM LIST + CONNECT-SEND-DOC-SELECTION (Oct 29, 2026, Wave A of the owner's 'Fix it all' run). A1 CONNECT-PICK: the v207 picker is now proven on the FULL path by a new harness (tools/connect-pick-persist-v278-test.js): approver taps ticks on a Limited request -> the REAL ConnectLive.respond writes exactly the ticked modules onto the request doc and the approver's con_list (proposal modules the driver account does not carry are filtered out; Navigation is tickable) -> the requester's reconcile materializes the same list -> ConnectPipe.modulesFor/allowsModule enforce exactly those ticks (unticked fuel/pnl stay shut). No picker code change was needed for A1 — the driven v207 path held end to end; the new suite is the persistence proof that was missing. A2 L2: a One-Time (and Limited) request now shows its item list on the REQUESTER's side too (outgoing rows carry a 'Covers:' line, matching the approver's 'Asking for:' line), and a re-send after a decline carries the item list again — the pre-v278 re-send dropped `modules` entirely, re-opening the pair as a blanket request. A3 CONNECT-SEND-DOC-SELECTION (reopened Oct 29): three real-account seams fixed in modules/connect.js. (1) PROFILE SCOPE: the Send-doc picker read the ACTIVE work profile's book, but Connect can only send the MAIN (Profile 1) book — sitting on a non-main profile, his saved items vanished ('No damage photos saved yet') and the non-main items it did list could never be sent (queueShare refused them all). The picker now reads the shareable Profile-1 book from any active profile (sticker photos read the main truck's chain), non-main items are not offered, and a listed item actually sends. (2) MANIFEST FIELD: every manifest_feed writer stores the entry text as `summary`; the picker read `text`, so real entries listed as a bare 'Manifest entry' and shared empty — it now reads `summary` (legacy `text` fallback kept). (3) DISPATCH SCOPE + PIN: the dispatch branch ignored the profile fence (a temp carrier's dispatch could be picked for a main connection) and its package dropped the record's pin — it is now fenced like every other branch and lat/lng, dump pin and pickup/dropoff ride the send, so a Connect-sent dispatch can offer Navigate on arrival. Harness tools/connect-send-doc-v278-test.js: RED 10/23 pre-fix on the writers' real record shapes -> GREEN 23/23. tools/connect-share-picker-v243-test.js P8 updated to the v278 shareable-book law (54/54). A4 DSP-MULTI-SEND: audit only, no code change — the check-off multi-send exists and is wired (modules/dispatch.js sendHtml/wirePipe -> ConnectPipe.sendDispatchToMany, per-driver verdicts), gated to non-Driver accounts with a non-'driver' face (dispatcher/office/fleet faces; a 'both' face on a non-Driver account included, Driver accounts never see the send card); harness proof dispatch-multi-send 43/45 (2 stale pins). What remains unproven is real-account physical proof with real tester accounts, exactly as ordered Oct 23 — parked for physical proof, not claimed live.
